subject: Request: POC window elongation due to integration blockers (NimbusPay)
messages:
From: Elena Vargas <elena@nimbuspay.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@nimbuspay.com
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: POC delay and ask: short extension + sandbox credits

Hi Jordan —

Quick note from our integration team: we hit an unexpected SAML assertion mismatch when connecting our internal IdP to the Redwood Private sandbox. The engineers are working through it but that blocker means we won't have the connector-ready demo for next Wednesday's exec review.

Can Redwood extend our POC window by two weeks and provide a small sandbox credit top-up (we estimate ~2k token-equivalent credits for resumed test runs)? Procurement is ready to finish the order but we'd like to avoid losing momentum. I'm attaching the most recent error logs and a saml trace.

Attachments: error-log-20260210.txt (text), saml-trace.pcap (pcap)

Happy to hop on a short call this afternoon if it helps.

Thanks,
Elena Vargas
Head of Integrations | NimbusPay
elena@nimbuspay.com
+1 415-555-0134
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Vargas <elena@nimbuspay.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC delay and ask: short extension + sandbox credits

Elena — thank you for the heads up and for sending the traces. Really appreciate the clear context.

Proposed quick path:
- Redwood grants a 14-calendar-day POC extension (adds runway through 03/01/2026).
- We apply a one-time 2,500 sandbox-credit top-up to NimbusPay's test cluster.
- We mark the account as "no-cost" during the extended window so you can run full end-to-end scenarios.

Ben — can you confirm commercial approval for the above? Lauren — can your team log the extension and attach the approval template to the HubSpot deal? I put links below.

If that works for you, Elena, we'll prepare a short confirmation (PDF) and a DocuSign for signature. We'll also schedule a 30-min integration checkpoint for Friday to ensure the SAML issue is moving.

Relevant links: HubSpot deal NP-2026-042: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/NP-2026-042
Extension template: https://redwood-docs.internal/extension-templates/NP-EXT-2026

-Jordan
